Operations.Name: IscsiTargetCreate
Operations.Description:
Create an iSCSI Target.

`groups` is a list of group dictionaries which provide information related to using a `portal`, `initiator`,
`authmethod` and `auth` with this target. `auth` represents a valid iSCSI Authorized Access and defaults to
null.

`auth_networks` is a list of IP/CIDR addresses which are allowed to use this initiator. If all networks are
to be allowed, this field should be left empty.

Arguments.Name: iscsi_target_create
Arguments.Description: iSCSI target configuration data for creation.

Operations.Name: IscsiTargetDelete
Operations.Description:
Delete iSCSI Target of `id`.

Deleting an iSCSI Target makes sure we delete all Associated Targets which use `id` iSCSI Target.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the iSCSI target to delete.

Arguments.Name: force
Arguments.Description: Whether to force deletion even if the target is in use.

Arguments.Name: delete_extents
Arguments.Description: Whether to also delete associated extents.

Operations.Name: IscsiTargetValidateName
Operations.Description:
Returns validation error for iSCSI target name
:param name: name to be validated
:param existing_id: id of an existing iSCSI target that will receive this name (or `None` if a new target
                    is being created)
:return: error message (or `None` if there is no error)

Arguments.Name: existing_id
Arguments.Description: ID of existing target to exclude from validation or `null` for new targets.

Fields.Description: ID of the authentication credential or `null` if no authentication.

Fields.Name: Authmethod
Fields.Description: Authentication method for this target group.

Fields.Name: Initiator
Fields.Description: ID of the authorized initiator group or `null` to allow any initiator.

Fields.Name: Portal
Fields.Description: ID of the iSCSI portal to use for this target group.

Fields.Description: Array of network addresses allowed to access this target.

Fields.Description: Array of portal-initiator group associations for this target.

Fields.Name: IscsiParameters
Fields.Description: Optional iSCSI-specific parameters for this target.

Fields.Name: Mode
Fields.Description:
Protocol mode for the target.

* `ISCSI`: iSCSI protocol only
* `FC`: Fibre Channel protocol only
* `BOTH`: Both iSCSI and Fibre Channel protocols

Fibre Channel may only be selected on TrueNAS Enterprise-licensed systems with a suitable Fibre Channel HBA.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Name of the iSCSI target (maximum 120 characters).
